name: @lacspace/audiomix
description: Mix a newsroom voiceover with a music bed: sidechain-duck the music under the voice, place SFX stings, and normalize to -14 LUFS — an ffmpeg command builder plus a licensed-music library loader (each track must carry a licence sidecar; emits the attribution line) and a deterministic tempo/beat detector for beat-synced cuts. No copyrighted platform music. Bring your own ffmpeg; zero third-party dependencies.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
